Its head is lowered toward the ground, revealing its two distinct horns and thick, wrinkled skin folds around its neck. In the background, there is a vibrant green lawn and a row of dark green vertical wooden posts forming a fence under bright, natural daylight. (2) The rhinoceros begins to walk slowly toward the left side of the frame, lifting its heavy legs one by one with a steady, rhythmic gait. The camera pans slowly to maintain the animal in a full shot, highlighting its massive physical presence and the texture of its dusty, grey hide as it moves across the concrete and toward the grassy patch. (3) The rhinoceros continues its slow progression, eventually stepping onto the grass. The background remains consistent with the wooden posts and lush foliage visible. The lighting is even and flat, suggesting a clear day. No human characters are visible, and the focus remains entirely on the animal's deliberate movements and physical state within its simulated natural habitat.

It uses a serious, professional narration style to describe a rhinoceros walking at Shoushan Zoo, ultimately leading to a linguistic pun. It aims to entertain viewers with a clever play on words while maintaining the aesthetic of high-quality wildlife programming.
